description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.
Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
Your agent team, in one group chat.
Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.
Your computers, working as one. Share keyboard, mouse, trackpad, clipboard, drag and drop and audio across Macs and PCs.

A lightweight PC Dynamic Island that integrates QQ, WeChat, and email notifications, clipboard history, quick translation, a Codex status light, media controls, daily to-dos, and more. | 轻量的PC灵动岛，集成QQ、微信及邮箱通知、剪贴历史、快捷翻译、Agent状态灯、媒体控制、每日待办等功能

iPad-first, open-source iOS AI Agent with native on-device 3D/CAD editing, iPhone support and Android alpha. On-device Linux, terminal, Python/Node.js, Git and web previews; BYOK AI, Notes, Office, Canvas, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
A personal agent that works on your life around the clock, on a Mac you own. One sentence to Claude Code installs it.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.
A fast, native scrollable-tiling window manager for macOS, inspired by Niri.
A dock and a launcher for Windows. Replaces the taskbar. Alt+Space grows the dock into a launcher. Rust and Win32, one ~1.5 MB exe.
One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotkey launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board.
浮屿：Windows 上的轻量灵动岛。在屏幕顶部汇总 QQ、微信和邮件通知，查看 Claude Code / Codex 的运行状态并直接在岛上审批，还有剪贴板历史、快捷翻译、音乐与歌词、待办、日历和文件中转，支持插件扩展。
